title: A2AMessage
description: Typed Agent-to-Agent message contract for peer requests, clarifications, rebuttals, and evidence handoff. Implements PATTERNS E4.1.

type.description: Message type governs routing and handling logic.

toAgentId.description: Target agent ID or broadcast token '_all'.

correlationId.description: Groups messages in the same conversation or workflow thread.

replyToId.description: ID of the message being replied to, if any.

payload.description: Message body. Contents vary by type.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the message intent.

body.description: Full markdown body (optional but recommended for non-trivial messages).

evidencePaths.description: File paths included as evidence or handoff artifacts.

clarificationQuestions.description: Ordered list of clarification questions for type=clarification.

requestedAction.description: Specific action requested of the target agent.

deadline.description: Optional deadline for the requested action.

provenance.description: Traceability metadata for every inter-agent message.

ttlSeconds.description: Message time-to-live in seconds. 0 = no expiry.
